bible.title: Bought Back
bible.kernel: Maulinie hires the company to buy each arsonist who burned her farm, the trail ending at Orla.

cast.name: Maulinie
cast.who: River widow who lost her homestead to fire and pays others to make it right.
cast.want: to buy each arsonist who burned her farm

cast.name: Orla
cast.who: Forest-born drifter who rode with the raiders and kept the stolen family circlet.
cast.want: to keep the circlet and sell the hoard's secret for coin

cast.name: Mossanon Elmwhisper
cast.who: Exiled woodcutter who joined the fire party and now trades leads for a cudgel.

bible.situation: Maulinie's farm was burned by three raiders who stole an old elven circlet among other things. The raiders split up afterward. One kept the circlet and the location of a small hoard of old elven silver. Maulinie has the coin and wants each man bought back so the circlet returns to her. The raider who holds the circlet resists being bought and will only meet where witnesses keep things honest.
bible.goal: To buy each arsonist who burned her farm.
arc: Go to the river ford the widow named and question travelers there using only her description → yields: Giruss, a passing arsonist found trading at the shallows.
Follow Giruss into the Western woods and use him to locate the next participant → yields: Mossanon Elmwhisper, who produces Orla's summons to meet at the ford for a trade.
Bring Mossanon's summons to the river ford and force Orla to trade the stolen elven circlet, then hand that circlet straight to Maulinie.
tensions: Orla will refuse coin and try to sell the circlet's secret to the highest bidder instead
Forest wardens and elven custom punish sale of elven items, risking interruption
Mossanon demands a blunt cudgel or he withholds Orla's summons until paid
openDirections: Rumors spread that the circlet belongs to a larger buried hoard, drawing other bands who may seize it first
bible.stakeIfLost: Maulinie loses the family circlet that she needs to settle her late husband's pledged debt, forcing her to sell her homestead.
bible.arrival: came up with the last carts · would not name the place until the terms were set

shipped.title: Question at the ford
shipped.situation: A river widow, Maulinie, came up with the last carts and would not name the place until the terms were set. She refuses the ford's name and says she will describe the crossing instead, and she watches your hands, not your face. She wants you to find the arsonists so she can buy them, and the fee is as agreed, and any spoils ride home with it. She says that if this fails she will lose the family circlet that settles her late husband's pledged debt. A raider means to keep the circlet and sell the hoard's secret for coin. The outcome she seeks now is that someone at the ford answers to her description when questioned.
shipped.job: Go to the river ford Maulinie described and question travelers there using only her description.
